description: This file defines a Summernote plugin called 'databasic' that adds a custom data container feature with UI buttons, dialogs, and popovers for editing and inserting data containers within the Summernote editor.

classes.name: DataBasicPlugin
classes.description: A constructor function defining the 'databasic' plugin for Summernote, managing UI buttons, dialogs, popovers, and data container nodes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates dialog markup and popover UI elements for the plugin.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes plugin UI elements from DOM.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the position and visibility of the popover based on the current selection.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current data node in the editor.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the HTML content of a data node.

methods.name: updateNode
methods.description: Updates the data node with new information.

methods.name: createNode
methods.description: Creates a new data node and inserts it into the editor.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Opens the dialog for editing or inserting a data container.

methods.name: openDialog
methods.description: Handles dialog display and user input for data container editing.
